banner.title: lidarr
banner.tagline: Music library manager on its own PostgreSQL 18 database, importing Usenet downloads into the NAS music share.

explainer.title: Database first, then the music library

steps.title: Database
steps.text: The lidarr-db Kustomization creates role and database lidarr on the shared postgres-18 Cluster. Both are retained if the app is removed.
steps.scene: a database cylinder gaining a new labelled drawer

steps.title: Secret
steps.text: ExternalSecret lidarr-secret holds the database settings, the API key and the postgres-init credentials, all from 1Password items lidarr and cloudnative-pg.
steps.scene: a key ring with several keys on a vault door

steps.title: Import
steps.text: init-dirs creates /data/nas-media/Music on the NAS. Lidarr reads downloads from the shared claim and imports finished albums into the library.
steps.scene: album tiles moving from a download folder into a music shelf

steps.title: Keep
steps.text: The 8Gi lidarr-config claim is backed up by kopiur. The data lives in PostgreSQL, which has its own barman backup.
steps.scene: a music disc sealed in an archive box

art.about: a music manager that keeps its state in PostgreSQL and imports finished downloads into a NAS library
art.title: How Lidarr imports music
